options.text: Everything Claude keeps in mind during this conversation
options.explanation: Correct. Messages, files and the results of commands all take up space in the context.

options.text: All the conversations you’ve ever had with Claude
options.explanation: Claude can’t see the content of earlier conversations. That’s why lasting instructions are written in CLAUDE.md.

options.text: The folder where the project is
options.explanation: The folder is where the project lives. The context is the conversation’s “desk”.

questions.question: You’re moving on to a completely new task, and Claude has started going round in circles. What do you do?

options.text: I start a new conversation with the command /clear
options.explanation: Exactly. A clean context often helps right away.

options.text: I keep going in the same conversation forever
options.explanation: A conversation that runs too long fills up the context, and Claude’s work gets worse.
There’s nothing wrong with the installation. A new conversation is enough.
